jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
jobs.content: <p>Nimbus Analytics builds forecasting and analytics software for mid-sized European manufacturers. Our Berlin team of 60 engineers ships every week.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Own the platform that trains and serves our forecasting models.</li><li>Make deployment boring for data scientists.</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years of experience writing production Python.</li><li>Hands-on experience running workloads on Kubernetes.</li><li>A track record in MLOps: model deployment, monitoring and retraining.</li><li>Experience training models with PyTorch.</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Experience with Airflow for orchestration.</li><li>Terraform for infrastructure.</li></ul><h3>Compensation</h3><p>€85,000 - €105,000 per year</p>

jobs.title: LLM Engineer, Retrieval
jobs.content: <p>Nimbus Analytics builds forecasting and analytics software for mid-sized European manufacturers. Our Berlin team of 60 engineers ships every week.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Work closely with product and engineering to ship improvements every week.</li><li>Own your work from design document to production.</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>Strong Python engineering skills.</li><li>Experience building applications with LLMs in production.</li><li>Hands-on RAG experience: chunking, retrieval and ranking.</li><li>You treat evaluation as a first-class part of the work.</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Experience with LangGraph or similar orchestration.</li><li>Familiarity with vector databases such as pgvector.</li></ul><h3>Compensation</h3><p>€80,000 - €100,000 per year</p>
